purpose: Preregister a CSEC Romania S13 F3 source probe capable of determining whether one exact monthly stock-flow boundary can be materialised without mixing units, currencies, maturities, valuations or consolidation states.
discovery_rule: Resolve remaining component keys from official CSEC metadata/data structure or provider query output. Candidate key syntax alone is not evidence.
materialisation_rule: Retain provider metadata and raw/normalized observations in a new immutable source vintage before any canonical model use.
identity_checks: net_issues = gross_issues - redemptions at provider precision
closing_stock[t] = closing_stock[t-1] + net_issues[t] + revaluations[t] + other_changes_in_volume[t] at provider precision
prohibited_shortcuts: do not substitute BNR domestic-primary-market issue volumes for CSEC all-market S13 gross issues
do not substitute QSA net incurrence for CSEC gross issues
do not infer redemptions as gross issues minus an unrelated net-issuance boundary
do not infer revaluations or other changes from Maastricht debt changes
do not merge market-valued CSEC F3 stock with nominal Maastricht debt
do not change feedback topology from a source-discovery result alone
